scripts.dev: npm run build -w @kanban/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @kanban/api" "npm run dev -w @kanban/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kanban/shared && npm run build -w @kanban/web && npm run build -w @kanban/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @kanban/api && npm run test -w @kanban/web
